To select a page range for an OCR request, use the **`pages`** parameter with a range (e.g., `"1-3"`) or a list (e.g., `"1,3,5"`).
Page numbering starts at **1**.

[Page selection](https://docs.mistral.ai/ai-services/ocr#page-selection)
